purpose: Global seamless 2D art contract and rough whole-world no-foreground base before final per-region painted sources.

coordinate_policy.world_space: Godot runtime coordinates from OutdoorWorld REGION_OFFSETS and REGION_SIZES
coordinate_policy.registration_target: registration-perfect layer alignment, not pixel-perfect brush tracing
coordinate_policy.single_region_source_rule: Each approved region painted_source is the single composition source for that region's layers.
coordinate_policy.seam_rule: Adjacent region sources must preserve shared road width, ground color, lighting direction, perspective, and edge continuation.

art_pipeline_decision.next_village_step: Generate a true storybook painted source only after this OutdoorWorld master blueprint is accepted.
art_pipeline_decision.reason: Isolated high-quality regions produced obvious seams; the base world must read as one map before region detail passes.
art_pipeline_decision.world_base_rule: Produce the whole no-foreground map first, even if rough.
art_pipeline_decision.foreground_rule: foreground occlusion is authored per region only after base continuity is accepted
